package http_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	transporthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/onboardinghandoff"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
)

const handoffRouteKey = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"

func TestOnboardingPlanHandoffRouteStrictAuthReplayAndDisabledNoRead(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	receipts := &routeHandoffReceipts{}
	router := handoffRouter(true, receipts, student)
	path := "/internal/students/" + readinessRouteStudentID + "/onboarding-plan-handoffs"
	body := `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, token string
		want        int
	}{
		{name: "wrong token", token: "teacher-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "dedicated token", token: "teacher-handoff-token", want: http.StatusCreated},
		{name: "exact replay", token: "teacher-handoff-token", want: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", handoffRouteKey)
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.want || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d cache=%q type=%q body=%s", response.Code, response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), response.Header().Get("Content-Type"), response.Body.String())
			}
			if testCase.want != http.StatusForbidden {
				if response.Header().Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
					t.Fatalf("content-type=%q", response.Header().Get("Content-Type"))
				}
				var result domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff
				if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil || result.Schema != domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema || result.ExecutionStatus != "NOT_STARTED" || result.ContentStatus != "NOT_CREATED" || result.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() || (testCase.want == http.StatusOK) != result.Replayed {
					t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	if student.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("student calls=%d", student.calls)
	}
	student.calls = 0
	disabled := handoffRouter(false, receipts, student)
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-handoff-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", handoffRouteKey)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	disabled.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || student.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("disabled replay status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, student.calls, response.Body.String())
	}
	request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-handoff-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555")
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response = httptest.NewRecorder()
	disabled.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || student.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("disabled new status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, student.calls, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestOnboardingPlanHandoffRouteRejectsUntrustedBodyBeforeStudentRead(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	router := handoffRouter(true, &routeHandoffReceipts{}, student)
	valid := `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name string
		body string
	}{
		{name: "unknown top-level field", body: valid[:len(valid)-1] + `,"goal_code":"go.backend"}`},
		{name: "unknown nested state-ref field", body: `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4,"extra":true},"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`},
		{name: "trailing JSON", body: valid + `{}`},
		{name: "null state ref", body: `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":null,"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`},
		{name: "oversized body", body: valid + strings.Repeat(" ", 16<<10)},
		{name: "noncanonical UUID", body: `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-33333333333A","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+readinessRouteStudentID+"/onboarding-plan-handoffs", bytes.NewBufferString(testCase.body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-handoff-token")
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", handoffRouteKey)
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity || student.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, student.calls, response.Body.String())
			}
			var envelope struct {
				Error struct {
					Code string `json:"code"`
				} `json:"error"`
			}
			if response.Header().Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" || json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &envelope) != nil || envelope.Error.Code != "invalid_request" {
				t.Fatalf("content-type=%q body=%s", response.Header().Get("Content-Type"), response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOnboardingPlanHandoffRouteRequiresOneByteCanonicalIdempotencyKey(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	router := handoffRouter(true, &routeHandoffReceipts{}, student)
	body := `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":4},"dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","teacher_job_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name string
		keys []string
	}{
		{name: "whitespace padded", keys: []string{" " + handoffRouteKey + " "}},
		{name: "duplicate values", keys: []string{handoffRouteKey, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+readinessRouteStudentID+"/onboarding-plan-handoffs", bytes.NewBufferString(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-handoff-token")
			request.Header["Idempotency-Key"] = testCase.keys
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity || student.calls != 0 || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(`"invalid_idempotency_key"`)) {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, student.calls, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func handoffRouter(enabled bool, receipts *routeHandoffReceipts, student *routeReadinessStudent) http.Handler {
	return transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "general-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token", TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken: "teacher-handoff-token", PracticeToken: "practice-token",
		OnboardingPlanHandoff: privatehandlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{Accept: onboardinghandoff.Acceptor{
			Enabled: enabled, Receipts: receipts, IDs: routeHandoffIDs{}, Clock: routeHandoffClock{},
			Readiness: readiness.Resolver{Enabled: true, Students: student, Graphs: &routeReadinessGraphs{}},
		}},
	})
}

type routeHandoffIDs struct{}

func (routeHandoffIDs) NewID() string { return "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666" }

type routeHandoffClock struct{}

func (routeHandoffClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

type routeHandoffReceipts struct {
	records map[string]domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord
}

func (stub *routeHandoffReceipts) GetByStudentAndIdempotency(_ context.Context, studentID, key string) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error) {
	if stub.records == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	record, ok := stub.records[studentID+key]
	if !ok {
		return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return record, nil
}
func (stub *routeHandoffReceipts) CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(_ context.Context, record domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, bool, error) {
	if stub.records == nil {
		stub.records = map[string]domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}
	}
	if prior, ok := stub.records[record.StudentID+record.IdempotencyKey]; ok {
		return prior, false, nil
	}
	stub.records[record.StudentID+record.IdempotencyKey] = record
	return record, true, nil
}
